examples.name: Channel with obstacles
examples.world:
val rows = 10
val cols = 10
val wall1Row = (rows * 0.3).toInt
val wall2Row = (rows * 0.6).toInt
val wall1Start = wall1Row * cols + 1
val wall1End = wall1Row * cols + (cols * 0.8).toInt
val wall2Start = wall2Row * cols + (cols * 0.2).toInt + 1
val wall2End = (wall2Row + 1) * cols
val wall1 = wall1Start to wall1End
val wall2 = wall2Start to wall2End
val targetId = (rows * cols).toString
var w = world
  .grid(rows = rows, cols = cols, stepX = 60.0, stepY = 60.0, tolerance = 10.0)
  .radius(70)
  .matrix(dimension = 3, color = "#bb66ff")
  .sensor("obstacle", false)
  .sensor("source", false)
  .sensor("target", false)
  .initial("1", "source", true)
  .initial(targetId, "target", true)
  .seed(config = 42L, simulation = 99L, randomSensor = 123L)
for (i <- wall1) {
  w = w.initial(i.toString, "obstacle", true)
}
for (i <- wall2) {
  w = w.initial(i.toString, "obstacle", true)
}
w

examples.name: Collect data
examples.body:
//using StandardSensors, BlockG, BlockC, Actuation
val nodeContribution = 1.0
val neutralValue = 0.0
def source : Boolean = sense("source")
def temperature : Double = sense[Double]("temperature")
val potential = distanceTo(source)
val totalTemperature = C[Double,Double](potential, _+_, temperature, neutralValue)
val count = C[Double, Double](potential, _ + _, nodeContribution, neutralValue)
val avg = totalTemperature / count
val t = (temperature - 10.0) / (30.0 - 10.0)
val hue = (240.0 / 360.0) * (1.0 - t)
val color = hsl(hue, 0.8, 0.55)
(mux[Any](source) { avg } { "" }, ledAll to color)

examples.name: complex shape
examples.body:
//using Actuation
val eyeRow = 1
val leftEyeCol = 1
val rightEyeCol = 3
val mouthRowUpper = 3
val mouthRowLower = 4
val mouthColOuterLeft = 0
val mouthColInnerLeft = 1
val mouthColCenter = 2
val mouthColInnerRight = 3
val mouthColOuterRight = 4

val eyes = Seq(
  ledAll to "white",
  led(eyeRow, leftEyeCol) to off,
  led(eyeRow, rightEyeCol) to off
)
val mouth = Seq(
  led(mouthRowUpper, mouthColOuterLeft) to off,
  led(mouthRowUpper, mouthColOuterRight) to off,
  led(mouthRowLower, mouthColInnerLeft) to off,
  led(mouthRowLower, mouthColCenter) to off,
  led(mouthRowLower, mouthColInnerRight) to off
)
eyes ++ mouth
